description: This file defines a PHP class 'Upload' within the Opencart CMS, specifically in the admin model for managing file uploads. It provides methods to add, delete, retrieve, and list uploaded files, interacting with a database table for uploads.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: A model class for handling upload records, including creating, deleting, retrieving, and listing uploads in the database.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with a generated token code.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record identified by its upload ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific upload by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Fetches a list of uploads based on optional filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Counts the total number of upload records matching optional filters.
